en.html:
Bright decoration, cheerful colors. Young people, please come. That was what the whole interior was saying.

Unfortunately, not one customer had obeyed. The empty chairs were receiving all this encouragement on their own. Enjoy your youth, chair. Make memories. Another exciting afternoon looking at the table.

Without people, all that cheerfulness only made the place feel colder. The room was insisting that a very good time was being had; somebody merely needed to arrive and have it.

The waitress's voice was still giving full welcome. No reduction for the absence of anybody to welcome.

She herself did not seem to find anything wrong. A young woman whose expressions did more for her face than its actual shape, I thought. Perfect business smile in place, she showed us to a table.

Window seat. Excellent view. Its usefulness to our present difficulty: none. But we were well away from the kitchen, and that was useful. Speak quietly and nobody should hear.

I sat on a well-kept chair.

Kageaki"Three reasons. Your hands. Your legs. Your eyes."
Ichijou"Only body parts! No, wait, that's not even the main problem!"
Inada"Everyone gets these lines from you, no?"
Kageaki"No. You only..."
Ichijou"Arre, WHAT HAS HAPPENED TO YOUR PERSONALITY!? Or were you always like this, you bloody fraud!? I've been betrayed—and THIS is the betrayal I'm getting!?"
Kageaki"Your hand... white, beautiful."
Kageaki"And at present... very cold."
Inada"Cold hands, warm heart—is that what you'll tell me?"
Kageaki"Folk sayings are not my interest. This hand—"
Ichijou"WASHING DISHES! She was washing dishes, Sherlock!"
Inada"Yes. Short of staff, so I help with everything. Dishes, food, drinks..."
Kageaki"So you do kitchen work also. Not only serve customers."
Kageaki"Yet the hands are not rough at all. White, beautiful, smooth. Instead, here at the base of the fingers, a thin callus."
Kageaki"The particular mark of someone trained with a sword."

ja.html:
稲田「お客様ったら。 　こんな可愛らしいお連れ様がいらっしゃる のに」
景明「今は貴方が気になるのです」
一条「みーなーとーさーんー!?」
稲田「そんなことを言って。 　もう、悪戯はお止めください」
景明「自分は本気です」
一条「なんでっ!?」
稲田「……困ったお客様」
景明「自分も困っています。 　こんな所で、貴方のような人と出会ってし まうとは」
一条「あたしも今すごい困ってるんですが!?」
稲田「お客様…… 　どうして？」
景明「三つあります。 　貴方の手、貴方の脚、貴方の瞳」
一条「身体だけかよ。 　いや、問題はそこじゃないけど！」
稲田「誰にでも、そんなこと仰るんでしょう？」
景明「いいえ。 　貴方だけです……」
一条「なんでいきなり人格キャラ変わってるんですか!? 　それとも元々そーいう人だったんですか!? あたし裏切られた!?　しかもよりにもよって こんな裏切られ方ーーー!?」
景明「貴方の手…… 　白く、綺麗で」
景明「今は……とても冷たい」
稲田「手の冷たい人は心が温かい、とでも仰るの かしら？」
景明「俗説に興味はありません。 　貴方のこの手は――」
一条「単に水仕事してきただけだと思います！」
稲田「ええ。 　人手が足りないので、皿洗いから飲食物の 準備まで手伝わないとならなくて」
景明「そうなのでしょう。 　貴方は接客だけでなく、厨房の仕事もして いる」
景明「だというのに、この手は全く荒れていない。 白く、綺麗で、滑らかだ。 　そのかわり、指の付け根に薄いたこ・・がある」
景明「これは剣の鍛錬を積んだ人間特有のもの」

en.html:
Ichijou"...Eh?"
Inada"————"
Kageaki"Your steps, the movement of your hips... I examined them carefully. Far too steady."
Kageaki"Ready for an attack at any moment. Without martial training, a person does not walk like that."
Ichijou"————"
Kageaki"And your eyes. Out of season, customers who are not local, but not the slightest suspicion."
Inada"............"
Kageaki"Very... puzzling. My interest in you is not decreasing."
Ichijou"Minato sir. Then this woman is..."
Kageaki"Yes. Only one conclusion is possible."
Kageaki"A waitress who happens to know martial arts and has just started working here."
Ichijou"WHAT!?"
Inada"Y-yes! Exactly!"
Kageaki"Of course not. Who hires new staff in this season? And for a new employee, you are far too practiced with customers."
Inada"Tch...!"

稲田「――――」

稲田「くっ……！」
